title: Tseitin Flattening Length Bound
statement: For every Boolean circuit tree $C$ on $n$ variables, the length of the flattened Tseitin formula associated with $C$, plus $3$, is at most $7$ times the size of $C$.
hypotheses_covered: $C$ is a Boolean circuit tree on $n$ variables
